nodes.name: Melt spinning and dealloying
nodes.procedure: Single-roller melt spinning technique to fabricate Al-Ni-Fe ribbons through metallurgical eutectic process. nodes.name: Corrosion engineering
nodes.procedure: Iron plate as the corrosion substrate and dissolved oxygen in aqueous solution containing Ni²⁺ as the corrodents, a magnified electrode (0.1 m²) encompassing uniformly and vertically aligned NiFe LDH nanosheet arrays was obtained driven by the redox potential difference.
nodes.source_text: Taking iron plate as the corrosion substrate... NiFe LDH nanosheet arrays was obtained

nodes.name: Fe(NO₃)₃ displacement reaction
nodes.procedure: The strong oxidizing property of Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ could be employed to trigger the displacement reaction with Ni substrate, the phase transformation to Ni(Fe)(OH)₂ was readily engineered on NF within 60 s by one-pot immersion in Fe(NO₃)₃ aqueous solution with an upscaled size of 0.2 m².
nodes.source_text: phase transformation to Ni(Fe)(OH)₂ was readily engineered on NF within 60 s by one-pot immersion in Fe(NO₃)₃ aqueous solution

nodes.name: hcp-featured NiFe nanoparticles in N-doped carbon
Pyrolysis of NiFe MOF
nodes.procedure: Pyrolysis enables the decomposition of organic compounds into carbon framework, hcp-featured NiFe nanoparticles confined in N-doped carbon could be obtained by pyrolyzing the NiFe binuclear metal-organic framework (MOF) precursor.
nodes.source_text: Pyrolysis enables the decomposition... pyrolyzing the NiFe binuclear metal-organic framework (MOF) precursor

nodes.name: Atmosphere corrosion
nodes.procedure: Fe³⁺-adsorbed NF adjacent to concentrated HNO₃ was placed in a sealing reactor, the volatilized acid vapor played a dominant role in the subsequent formation of ionized NiFe LDH.
nodes.source_text: Fu's group proposed an atmosphere corrosion approach... volatilized acid vapor played a dominant role

nodes.description: OER activity in 30 wt% KOH electrolyte
nodes.source_text: Porous Raney Ni electrodes are widely employed in industrial alkaline electrolyzer, but suffer from insufficient OER activity (≈400 mV overpotential at 400 mA cm⁻² even in 30 wt.% KOH electrolyte)
Remarkably, the optimized Ni₂Fe₁-O catalyst with mesoporous network exhibited a minimized OER overpotential of 244 mV at 10 mA cm⁻² with a small Tafel slope of 39 mV dec⁻¹

nodes.description: OER performance in 30 wt% KOH at high current density
nodes.source_text: the NiFe LDH/NiS heterostructure demonstrated a favorable OER kinetics, with an impressive overpotential of 325 mV to achieve a current density of 1000 mA cm⁻². The scaling-up feasibility... was showcased by implanting the large-area NiFe LDH/NiS electrode into a 20 cm² one-stack alkaline hydrogen generator. A minimized electricity consumption of 0.215 kW h Nm⁻³ was recorded at a practical operation of 8000 mA during 80 h in 30 wt.% KOH media
